Ian Loron de Almeida is a M.Sc. student in Computer Science at the Institute of Computing at the University of Campinas (IC - UNICAMP). He is a member of the Hub of Artificial Intelligence and Cognitive Architectures (HIAAC), performing research in Multi-objective learning, mainly in the area of Credit Risk Decision-Making.

## Interests

- Machine Learning
- Multi-Objective Optimization
- AI Ethics
